review.assessment: This change replaces the stub raising NotImplementedError with a complete greedy word-wrapping implementation. It splits input text on whitespace, accumulates words onto lines until the next word would exceed `width`, and flushes lines appropriately. Words longer than `width` naturally start fresh lines without being split mid-word.
